title: Dependency Injection Basics
description: Understand dependency injection in ASP.NET Core.

data.text: **Dependency Injection (DI)** is a design pattern where objects receive their dependencies from external sources rather than creating them internally.

terms.definition: An object that another object depends on to function.
A principle where the control of object creation is transferred to a container.
A reusable component registered with the DI container.
The built-in ASP.NET Core mechanism that manages service lifetimes and resolves dependencies.

data.caption: Dependency injection flow in ASP.NET Core
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[Program.cs] -->|Registers| B[DI Container]
    B -->|Resolves| C[Controller]
    C -->|Uses| D[Service]
    D -->|Depends on| E[Repository]
    B -->|Creates| E
